title: Distribute Money to Maximum Children
summary: Given an integer money representing the total amount of money in dollars and an integer children representing the number of children to distribute the money to, distribute the money such that all money is given out, each child gets at least 1 dollar, and no child gets 4 dollars.
statement: Given an integer money representing the total amount of money in dollars and an integer children representing the number of children to distribute the money to, distribute the money such that all money is given out, each child gets at least 1 dollar, and no child gets 4 dollars. Return the maximum number of children who can receive exactly 8 dollars. If distribution is impossible, return -1.
constraints: Distribute all money while every child receives at least one dollar.
No child may receive exactly four dollars.
Return the maximum number receiving exactly eight dollars, or -1 if the minimum distribution is impossible.
reference_solution:
def maximum_eight_dollar_children(money,children):
    if money<children:return -1
    money-=children
    eights=min(children,money//7);money-=eights*7
    if eights==children and money>0:eights-=1
    elif eights==children-1 and money==3:eights-=1
    return eights

def maximum_eight_dollar_children(money,children):
    if money<children:return -1
    money-=children

hints: First reserve one dollar for every child; if that is impossible, return -1.
Use each complete block of seven remaining dollars to raise one child from one to eight.
If all children reached eight but money remains, reduce the count by one; also avoid leaving exactly three extra dollars on the sole non-eight child.
These are the only two boundary corrections because every other remainder can be absorbed without creating a four-dollar child.

tests.explanation: After giving everyone one dollar, one child can receive seven more without forcing a four-dollar child.
Both children can receive exactly eight dollars.
